players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (thumb) as of 10:54 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Jackson (ankle) practiced fully all week and carries no designation, and Week 8 injury roundups on Nov. 1 report he is cleared to play Sunday at Buffalo after missing three games. Tyler Huntley returns to a backup role.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.note: Daniels (elbow) practiced fully during Week 8 prep (Oct. 28-29) and has no reported setbacks ahead of Sunday's Nov. 1 game. He should play without limitations.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Mayfield is still far from 100 percent with a thumb injury after throwing only 11 passes in Week 7, and WR Emeka Egbuka has been ruled out for Week 8 against Atlanta. Several Week 8 previews call him a sit.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: Hurts remains on season-ending IR after blood clots were found in his lungs. Tanner McKee starts for the Eagles in Week 8.

players.name: Tanner McKee
players.note: McKee starts again in Week 8 (Nov. 1) with Jalen Hurts on season-ending IR, and no benching has been reported despite a four-game skid. He is a volatile superflex QB2.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: McCarthy remains the Giants' starter with Jaxson Dart out for the season, coming off 252 passing yards in the Oct. 25 OT win at Houston. The Giants are on bye in Week 8.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: Dart (IR) is out for the 2026 season after surgery to repair the meniscus and MCL in his left knee. J.J. McCarthy has the Giants' starting job.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: Brissett starts Week 8 at Dallas on Nov. 1, as coach Mike LaFleur reaffirmed this week. Backup Carson Beck is questionable with a back injury.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 9:43 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Beck (back) is questionable for Sunday's Nov. 1 game at Dallas, and reports point to a Beck debut later in the season, possibly around Week 12. Jacoby Brissett remains the starter.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: Klint Kubiak reaffirmed Cousins as the Raiders' starter for Week 8 against the Jets on Nov. 1 and shut down talk of a QB change.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: Cousins starts Week 8 against the Jets, and ESPN's Dan Graziano said this week he would be surprised if Mendoza starts any of the next five games. That points to a Dec. 13 debut at the earliest.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (quadriceps) as of 8:47 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Hall (quad) is questionable for Sunday, Nov. 1, after being limited all week, Oct. 28-30. Expect him to be active, but with a reduced workload in a committee with Braelon Allen.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) was placed on injured reserve on Oct. 31 after being ruled out for Week 8 vs. Kansas City. Jonah Coleman had already moved ahead of him.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: With RJ Harvey on IR (knee) as of Oct. 31, Coleman leads Denver's backfield with J.K. Dobbins for Week 8 vs. Kansas City. Coleman played 50% of the snaps in his Oct. 25 return.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Harvey's IR move on Oct. 31 leaves Dobbins as Jonah Coleman's only backfield partner, but Coleman out-snapped him heavily on Oct. 25.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Robinson (hamstring) is out for Week 8 vs. Tampa Bay on Nov. 1, his second straight missed game.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) is out for Week 8 at Cincinnati on Nov. 1.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: With Tyjae Spears (knee) out, Pollard should get a bigger workload Sunday, Nov. 1, at Cincinnati.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Henderson (illness) was downgraded to out on Oct. 31 for Sunday's game at Miami after missing practice Oct. 29-30.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: With TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out on Oct. 31, Stevenson should lead New England's backfield Sunday at Miami.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (thumb/toe) was ruled out on Oct. 31 for Monday night's game at Seattle on Nov. 2.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.note: With Kyle Monangai ruled out on Oct. 31, Swift should lead Chicago's backfield Monday, Nov. 2, at Seattle.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.note: As of Nov. 1, Seattle had not reported activating Price (chest) from IR for Monday's game vs. Chicago. Zach Charbonnet is off the injury report, which further clouds Price's role.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Charbonnet (ACL) came off the injury report on Oct. 31 and is in line for his 2026 debut Monday, Nov. 2, vs. Chicago. Expect a limited workload at first.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 9:43 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Gainwell (hip) is questionable for Week 8 vs. Atlanta on Nov. 1. Bucky Irving practiced fully and has no designation, so Gainwell stays a handcuff.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.note: McCaffrey is listed as questionable after a left thigh injury on Oct. 25 at Atlanta, where he returned and scored. San Francisco's Week 8 bye gives him time to recover before Week 9 vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) is out. He is considered week-to-week and missed Weeks 6-7, with Woody Marks leading Houston's backfield.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks is listed as questionable after a leg injury in the Oct. 25 game. He has been Houston's lead back while David Montgomery (groin) is out.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Skattebo is listed as questionable heading into Week 8 (Nov. 1). No further detail on his injury was available.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.note: Aaron Jones (knee) has no designation for Week 8 at Detroit on Nov. 1 and is expected to play. Mason likely goes back to a secondary role.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley (hamstring/back) has no designation for Sunday night, Nov. 1, at Washington. He said he will have to manage the injuries, so his workload may be trimmed.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown is out for Sunday (Nov 1) vs. Miami, with ESPN's inactives update citing his knee. He had already been dealing with ankle and knee issues on the Friday (Oct 30) report.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: With A.J. Brown ruled out for Nov 1 vs. Miami and Romeo Doubs and Mack Hollins on IR, Douglas should be one of New England's top targets this week.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:47 PM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Waddle (chest) is questionable for Sunday (Nov 1) vs. Kansas City (4:25 ET), and Adam Schefter reports he is trending toward playing. Other outlets still had him around 50/50 after two limited practices, so confirm at Denver's inactives.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 8:47 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Pickens (shoulder, hamstring) is questionable for Sunday (Nov 1) vs. Arizona but is reportedly expected to play. If he sits, Ryan Flournoy moves up.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 1:46 PM PT Nov 1.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 8:47 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Meyers (hamstring, ankle) is questionable for Sunday (Nov 1) vs. the Colts. Reports are pessimistic after he was a non-participant on Friday (Oct 30), and Yahoo expects him to sit.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) is out for Sunday (Nov 1) at Cincinnati after missing practice all week.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) is out again for Sunday (Nov 1) at Washington after being held out of practice. Philadelphia has given no timeline, and one outlet projects him out until after the Week 10 bye.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: Egbuka (foot, concussion) is out for Sunday (Nov 1) vs. Atlanta, per ESPN's Week 8 inactives update.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (quad) is out for Week 8, per Sleeper as of Oct 30. This is a recurrence of the quad injury that cost him Weeks 3-5.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel (hamstring) has missed two straight games. San Francisco is on bye in Week 8, and he is targeting a Week 9 return.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR with a ruptured hamstring, and Sean McVay has given a 6-10 week timeline.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce remains on IR with a heel injury. Shane Steichen said his practice window is 'most likely not' opening in Week 8.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: With Terry McLaurin out for the season (torn patellar tendon), Williams steps in as Washington's WR2 behind Stefon Diggs, starting Nov 1 vs. Philadelphia.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Bernard has drawn at least 5 targets in three straight games, including 3-27 in the Oct 25 win over New Orleans. He remains Pittsburgh's WR2 while Michael Pittman Jr. is on IR.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Lane out-routed and out-targeted Rashod Bateman in Week 7 and is working as Baltimore's WR2. Lamar Jackson is reportedly set to return Nov 1 at Buffalo.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 9:43 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Sarratt was a healthy scratch on Oct 25 and sits behind Ja'Kobi Lane for Baltimore's WR2 role.

players.name: Devaughn Vele
players.note: Vele led the Saints' receivers with a 92% snap share in Week 7 (Chris Olave played 58%) and has drawn at least six targets in every game.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Douglas returned from his ankle injury on Oct 25, played 68% of the snaps and scored a 63-yard TD on just 3 targets.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Caleb Douglas's return on Oct 25 pushed Bell back to Miami's WR3 role, which lowers his weekly floor.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Adam Schefter reported Oct 31 that there is 'no way' the Jets trade Wilson before the Nov 10 deadline, despite Kansas City's interest. He has only 9 targets over his last two games as rookie Omar Cooper Jr. emerges.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Shaheed (knee) is listed out on Sleeper as of Oct 31 and isn't expected to play Monday, Nov 2 vs. Chicago, though Mike Macdonald called the injury not long-term. Tory Horton would take the WR3 snaps.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: Downs requested a trade from the Colts (ESPN's Fowler, Oct 28), and WR-needy teams have called Indianapolis. No deal had been reported as of Nov 1; the deadline is Nov 10.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: Allen played just 30 snaps on Oct 25 (3-31). If Josh Downs gets the trade he requested before the Nov 10 deadline, Allen's slot role could grow.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Rice (hamstring/knee) was off the injury report by Oct 30 after limited practices and is set to return Sunday, Nov 1 at Denver for his first game since Week 4. Confirm he's active before kickoff.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Worthy went 3-11 on 6 targets on Oct 25, and Rashee Rice is set to return Nov 1 at Denver, which should cut into Worthy's target share.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Harris (hamstring) came off the injury report by Oct 30 and is in line to play Nov 1 vs. the Rams for the first time since Week 5.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (concussion, Oct 18) practiced fully this week and has no injury designation, so he looks set to play Nov 1 vs. the Rams. Confirm he's active before kickoff.

players.name: Matthew Golden
players.note: Golden played through shoulder and foot issues in the Oct 29 TNF win over Carolina and had 7 catches on 13 targets for 79 yards and a TD.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: Lemon had 7-67-1 on Oct 26, and DeVonta Smith missed practice again Oct 29. Lemon may lead Philadelphia's WRs again Sunday night, Nov 1 at Washington; check Smith's status before kickoff.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden played 61% of the snaps on Oct 22 and led Chicago with 4-130-1, outproducing Rome Odunze for the second straight week. The Bears play at Seattle on Monday, Nov 2.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Rookie Cooper was a top waiver add heading into Week 8 after another big Week 7 and looks like the Jets' ascending receiver.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Dell played 14 snaps in his Oct 25 return and had a 43-yard catch, one more snap than Marvin Harrison Jr. Houston is on bye in Week 8.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison played just 13 snaps (1-6) in the Oct 25 OT loss to the Giants, one fewer than Tank Dell. Houston is on bye in Week 8.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (ribs/Achilles) missed the Oct 25 game at Atlanta, and the 49ers are on bye in Week 8, so Week 9 is his earliest possible return.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and is out at least through Week 10.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson (hamstring) remains on IR, and reports point to a Week 9 return after the Saints' Week 8 bye.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19. He's on IR and out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: As of Nov 1, Hill (torn ACL, Sept 2025) is still an unsigned free agent, and no signing has been reported since his agent said in early October that he could sign soon.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 8:47 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Kincaid (chest) remains questionable for Sunday's Nov 1 game against Baltimore after practicing in a non-contact jersey Friday. Reports lean toward him playing, but check Buffalo's inactives around 11:30 a.m. ET.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: Warren (groin) is off the injury report and expected to return against Jacksonville on Nov 1 after missing two games. Usage in his first game back could be managed.

players.name: Max Klare
players.note: Starter Colby Parkinson (ribs) missed practice all week and is questionable for Sunday's Nov 1 game against the Chargers, with Terrance Ferguson still on IR. If Parkinson sits, Klare should see an expanded role.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.note: With Terry McLaurin out for the season, Okonkwo has a bigger target share in Washington and is a popular TE pickup. Washington hosts the Eagles on Nov 1.

players.name: Mike Gesicki
players.note: Erick All Jr. went on IR on Oct 27 with a feared torn ACL, leaving Gesicki as Cincinnati's lead receiving TE. The Bengals face Tennessee on Nov 1.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (ankle) remains on IR, and his practice window was not opened during Week 8 prep (per Oct 28 reports). One speculative timeline points to about Week 12.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ribs) as of 3:43 PM PT Nov 1.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:54 PM PT Oct 29. Earlier: Allen was limited Wednesday, Oct 28, with a new ankle injury that is not believed to be serious, and Breece Hall (quad) was also limited. Allen ran for 104 yards on Oct 25, but his workload shrinks if Hall returns.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:53 PM PT Oct 29. Earlier: Bowers (calf) was limited in Wednesday's practice on Oct 28, the first Week 8 report. The hamstring listed alongside it in Week 7 seems to be behind him.

players.name: Malik Washington
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:52 PM PT Oct 30. Earlier: Washington (knee) was limited again on Oct 29 after a limited session Oct 28. He's expected to be cleared off the injury report Friday, barring a setback.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:54 PM PT Oct 29. Earlier: Sampson (knee) was limited at practice Wednesday, Oct 28. He played 47% of the snaps in Week 7 and is a PPR RB3 alongside Quinshon Judkins.

players.name: Colston Loveland
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:47 PM PT Oct 31. Earlier: Loveland (neck) was limited in Friday's practice on Oct 30 and is questionable, but early reports expect him to play Monday night at Seattle on Nov 2. With Cole Kmet out for the year, he remains Chicago's lead TE if active.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (ankle) as of 1:46 PM PT Nov 1.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:54 PM PT Oct 30. Earlier: Kelce (ankle, hurt in Week 6) went from a full practice on Wednesday to limited on Thursday, Oct 29, and the Chiefs list him as questionable for Sunday's game at Denver. The final designation is due Friday, Oct 30.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:53 PM PT Oct 29. Earlier: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hand) as of 4:46 PM PT Oct 28. Earlier: Diggs (24-214-4 in five games) is Washington's de facto WR1 coming off the Week 7 bye. Terry McLaurin tore his patellar tendon on Oct 19.

players.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 11:56 AM PT Oct 30. Earlier: Jones (knee) was limited at practice Thursday, Oct 29, after sitting out Wednesday, which is a step toward playing in Week 8 at Detroit. Jordan Mason would take more carries if Jones is held back.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 10:54 AM PT Nov 1.

players.name: Ja'Marr Chase
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:54 PM PT Oct 29. Earlier: He did not practice Wednesday (Oct 28), listed as a veteran rest day with an ankle injury. Reports do not believe he is in danger of missing Week 8.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:48 PM PT Oct 30. Earlier: Allgeier (toe) was upgraded to limited practice Thursday, Oct 29. Jeremiyah Love was also limited, so Allgeier's Week 8 role at Dallas is unclear.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 7:06 PM PT Oct 29. Earlier: Matthew Golden's status for TNF on Oct 29 is unclear; reports conflict on whether he practiced Wednesday. If Golden sits, Green Bay's passing game should funnel through Watson and Tucker Kraft.

players.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:54 PM PT Oct 29. Sione Vaki and Jacob Saylors would handle the work if he misses Week 8 vs. Minnesota.
